# Paul Norris
## Paul Norris
### Tenure
1982 – 1990s
**Paul Norris** is a former Hot Wheels designer who worked with Mattel from 1982 to the 1990s. Norris mainly worked on playsets during his tenure at Hot Wheels but designed the Splittin' Image II alongside Bruce Baur and worked on the Mechanix line.
